Asia/Riyadh is UTC+3 (no DST historically).  
US/Eastern is UTC-5 (no DST in 1319).  
Time difference: UTC-5 minus UTC+3 = -8 hours.  
3 AM Riyadh (UTC+3) = 0 AM UTC.  
0 AM UTC - 8 hours = 16:00 previous day UTC.  
In US/Eastern (UTC-5), that's 16:00 same calendar date as UTC (since time zone offset applied directly).  
So 0 AM UTC Sept 28 1319 → 16:00 Sept 27 1319 US/Eastern.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1319-09-27 16:00
